001package com.fs.starfarer.api.ui;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.FaderUtil;
006
007public interface UIPanelAPI extends UIComponentAPI {
008
009        PositionAPI addComponent(UIComponentAPI custom);
010        void removeComponent(UIComponentAPI component);
011        void bringComponentToTop(UIComponentAPI c);
012        void sendToBottom(UIComponentAPI c);
013        
014        
015        /**
016         * The only method that accepts an arbitrary, non-core implementation of UIComponentAPI.
017         * Will wrap it with an internal implementation that delegate functionality to the passed-in component.
018         * Returns the wrapper; if need to call removeComponent, pass in the wrapper returned by this method. 
019         * @param component
020         * @param fader
021         * @return
022         */
023        UIComponentAPI wrapAndAdd(UIComponentAPI component, FaderUtil fader);
024        
025        /**
026         * Intended for use with custom components wrapped by UIPanelAPI.wrapAndAdd().
027         * @return
028         */
029        PositionAPI createPosition();
030        void clearChildren();
031        List<UIComponentAPI> getChildrenCopy2();
032}
